name: gapfinder-v2
frozen_before_run: 2026-09-25T04:48Z (first v2 attempt aborted before selection after a known-proxy leak was found in the log; evidence/gapfinder-v2-aborted.log. No v2 selection or audit was computed.)
objective: Predict fault pixels NOT already in labels.tif. Official staff answers: the known-fault scoring mask is pixel-exact and identical to the training labels; 'new fault' includes newly mapped geometry of existing systems; predictions near (not on) known traces are fully penalized.
buffer_rationale: 30 px feature radius + ridge smoothing/NMS support (~5 px) + 3 px metric kernel = 38 px < 48 px
fold_rotation_note: Riftline tuned on fold 0 and read its audit on fold 1. Gapfinder evaluates only on folds 2 and 3, which were never used as Riftline evaluation regions.

arms.role: new: supplied labels plus independent USGS SGMC fault traces in the TRAINING folds only
new: learns only from faults the supplied catalogue does not contain

halo_meaning: zero emitted pixels with 0 < distance-to-known <= halo; known pixels themselves are always 0 (masked by the scorer)
tip_meaning: straight along-strike ray beyond each free end of the supplied fault skeleton, direction from its last 8 skeleton pixels
emission: binary oriented-ridge (Hessian NMS) - linear-fractional DTI favours binary emission

proxies.gap: SGMC fault pixels >= 3.2 px from any known pixel (legacy proxy value 2)
proxies.all: all SGMC fault pixels not exactly on a known pixel (proxy values 1 or 2, minus known)
proxies.evaluation_mask: template-valid AND NOT known AND fold interior (competition-faithful: known pixels excluded as the organisers do)
proxies.known: supplied labels inside the tuning/audit fold interior (the model never trained there); scored with known pixels emit-able and no known mask - a stand-in for 'faults unseen by the model' of the Qfault type; tip-extension rays are NOT counted for this proxy (they are built from the known traces, so counting them would leak)

selection: maximize min(DTI_gap, DTI_all, DTI_known) on the tuning fold among eligible candidates; tie-break lower prediction mass, then arm, floor, halo, tip
refit: fraction-consistent sampling: the refit keeps every exact positive and samples near/unlabeled strata at the SAME inclusion fractions used for the holdout model, so the class mixture does not drift (fix for Riftline's refit failure). Accept refit only if its full-grid support passes the gate AND is within a factor 1.5 of the holdout model's full-grid support; otherwise publish the unchanged holdout model.

portfolio.fusion: selected ML emission OR SGMC-gap traces (p=1)
portfolio.sgmc-gap: SGMC-gap traces only (pure hypothesis test; no model)

portfolio_rationale: SGMC is also the local proxy, so the value of adding SGMC traces directly CANNOT be measured locally without circularity. It is a leaderboard experiment: fusion minus ml isolates it.
score_warning: All local numbers use public catalogues, not hidden expert labels. No leaderboard score is implied.
amendment: v1 (configs/gapfinder.json, evidence/gapfinder-v1-experiment.json) selected sgmc-target by min(gap, all) on the tuning fold. A POST-HOC audit diagnostic (evidence/gapfinder-diagnostics.json) showed that arm finds held-out supplied faults poorly (0.108 vs 0.200 for the control), i.e. it is source-specialised. Because the hidden expert faults may be Qfault-like scarps or SGMC-like bedrock faults, v2 adds a third proxy - held-out supplied faults in the TUNING fold - and selects by the minimum over all three. Disclosure: this rule was motivated by v1 audit numbers, so the fold-3 audit is NOT an independent confirmation for v2.
